ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: The image shows that the folded paper box is a rectangular open box without a top cover; the bottom face and four side faces can be seen, and the dashed lines indicate the hidden internal edges. According to the problem statement, the original cardboard is 20×30, and a 5×5 square is cut from each corner, so the height of the box after folding up is 5. The two directions of the bottom face each need to subtract two 5s: the width is 20-2×5=10, and the length is 30-2×5=20. The internal surface area includes only the bottom face and the four inner side faces, not including the top face. The area of the bottom face is 10×20=200; the area of the two long side faces is 2×(20×5)=200; the area of the two short side faces is 2×(10×5)=100. The total internal surface area is 200+200+100=500.

method.method_draft: Use the cut-and-fold dimensions to compute the interior faces of the open box. From the text, the original cardboard is 20 by 30 and each removed corner square is 5 by 5, so folding creates a box of height 5. The base dimensions are reduced by 10 in each direction: 20 - 2(5) = 10 and 30 - 2(5) = 20. From the image, confirm the box is open at the top, so the interior surface area includes only the bottom and four side faces. Compute bottom area 10 × 20 = 200, two long side areas 2(20 × 5) = 200, and two short side areas 2(10 × 5) = 100. Sum 200 + 200 + 100 = 500.

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: This is the direct geometric decomposition route: determine the folded box dimensions and add the areas of the five interior faces. It relies on explicit face-by-face area calculation rather than, for example, subtracting removed material from the original sheet.
planner_metadata.image_role: The image confirms the physical configuration is an open-top rectangular box with four vertical sides and a bottom, so no top face should be included in the interior surface area.
planner_metadata.text_role: The text provides all numerical dimensions: the original rectangle is 20 by 30, and each removed corner square has side length 5.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use the net-to-box relationship: cutting out squares of side x makes box height x and reduces each base dimension by 2x; surface area of a rectangular face is length times width, and an open box has five interior faces.
